description: Takes two integers and returns a single integer.

functions.name: sum_numbers
functions.description: Returns the sum of the two integers.
functions.code:
def sum_numbers(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b

functions.name: difference_ab
functions.description: Returns the first integer minus the second.
functions.code:
def difference_ab(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a - b

functions.name: difference_ba
functions.description: Returns the second integer minus the first.
functions.code:
def difference_ba(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return b - a

functions.name: product_numbers
functions.description: Returns the product of the two integers.
functions.code:
def product_numbers(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * b

functions.name: max_of_two
functions.description: Returns the larger of the two integers.
functions.code:
def max_of_two(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a if a > b else b

functions.name: min_of_two
functions.description: Returns the smaller of the two integers.
functions.code:
def min_of_two(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a if a < b else b

functions.name: absolute_sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of the absolute values.
functions.code:
def absolute_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) + abs(b)

functions.name: absolute_difference
functions.description: Returns the absolute difference between the integers.
functions.code:
def absolute_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a - b)

functions.name: square_sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of the squares of the integers.
functions.code:
def square_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * a + b * b

functions.name: cube_sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of the cubes of the integers.
functions.code:
def cube_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * a * a + b * b * b

functions.name: sum_plus_product
functions.description: Returns the sum plus the product of the integers.
functions.code:
def sum_plus_product(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b + a * b

functions.name: product_minus_sum
functions.description: Returns the product minus the sum of the integers.
functions.code:
def product_minus_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * b - (a + b)

functions.name: double_first_plus_second
functions.description: Returns twice the first integer plus the second.
functions.code:
def double_first_plus_second(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 2 * a + b

functions.name: double_second_plus_first
functions.description: Returns twice the second integer plus the first.
functions.code:
def double_second_plus_first(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + 2 * b

functions.name: weighted_difference
functions.description: Returns three times the first minus two times the second.
functions.code:
def weighted_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 3 * a - 2 * b

functions.name: sum_of_successors
functions.description: Returns the sum of the next integers after each input.
functions.code:
def sum_of_successors(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + 1) + (b + 1)

functions.name: sum_of_predecessors
functions.description: Returns the sum of the previous integers before each input.
functions.code:
def sum_of_predecessors(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a - 1) + (b - 1)

functions.name: larger_absolute_value
functions.description: Returns the larger absolute value of the two integers.
functions.code:
def larger_absolute_value(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) if abs(a) > abs(b) else abs(b)

functions.name: smaller_absolute_value
functions.description: Returns the smaller absolute value of the two integers.
functions.code:
def smaller_absolute_value(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) if abs(a) < abs(b) else abs(b)

functions.name: sign_agreement_flag
functions.description: Returns 1 if both integers have the same sign or either is zero, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def sign_agreement_flag(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if a * b >= 0 else 0

functions.name: is_first_greater_flag
functions.description: Returns 1 if the first integer is greater than the second, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def is_first_greater_flag(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if a > b else 0

functions.name: is_equal_flag
functions.description: Returns 1 if the two integers are equal, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def is_equal_flag(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if a == b else 0

functions.name: parity_match_flag
functions.description: Returns 1 if both integers have the same parity, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def parity_match_flag(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if a % 2 == b % 2 else 0

functions.name: odd_count
functions.description: Returns how many of the two integers are odd.
functions.code:
def odd_count(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a % 2) + (b % 2)

functions.name: even_count
functions.description: Returns how many of the two integers are even.
functions.code:
def even_count(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (1 if a % 2 == 0 else 0) + (1 if b % 2 == 0 else 0)

functions.name: sum_if_positive
functions.description: Returns the sum of inputs that are positive.
functions.code:
def sum_if_positive(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a if a > 0 else 0) + (b if b > 0 else 0)

functions.name: sum_if_negative
functions.description: Returns the sum of inputs that are negative.
functions.code:
def sum_if_negative(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a if a < 0 else 0) + (b if b < 0 else 0)

functions.name: positive_count
functions.description: Returns how many of the integers are positive.
functions.code:
def positive_count(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (1 if a > 0 else 0) + (1 if b > 0 else 0)

functions.name: negative_count
functions.description: Returns how many of the integers are negative.
functions.code:
def negative_count(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (1 if a < 0 else 0) + (1 if b < 0 else 0)

functions.name: nonzero_count
functions.description: Returns how many of the integers are nonzero.
functions.code:
def nonzero_count(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (1 if a != 0 else 0) + (1 if b != 0 else 0)

functions.name: distance_from_ten_sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of distances from 10 for both integers.
functions.code:
def distance_from_ten_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a - 10) + abs(b - 10)

functions.name: distance_from_zero_difference
functions.description: Returns the difference between the absolute values.
functions.code:
def distance_from_zero_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) - abs(b)

functions.name: sum_mod_five
functions.description: Returns the sum of each integer reduced modulo 5.
functions.code:
def sum_mod_five(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a % 5) + (b % 5)

functions.name: product_mod_seven
functions.description: Returns the product reduced modulo 7.
functions.code:
def product_mod_seven(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a * b) % 7

functions.name: floor_div_sum_by_two
functions.description: Returns the floor of the sum divided by 2.
functions.code:
def floor_div_sum_by_two(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + b) // 2

functions.name: average_rounded_down
functions.description: Returns the arithmetic mean rounded down.
functions.code:
def average_rounded_down(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + b) // 2

functions.name: remainder_a_by_abs_b_plus_one
functions.description: Returns a modulo one more than the absolute value of b.
functions.code:
def remainder_a_by_abs_b_plus_one(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a % (abs(b) + 1)

functions.name: remainder_b_by_abs_a_plus_one
functions.description: Returns b modulo one more than the absolute value of a.
functions.code:
def remainder_b_by_abs_a_plus_one(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return b % (abs(a) + 1)

functions.name: sum_of_digit_lengths
functions.description: Returns the total number of digits in the decimal forms ignoring signs.
functions.code:
def sum_of_digit_lengths(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return len(str(abs(a))) + len(str(abs(b)))

functions.name: first_digit_sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of the first decimal digits ignoring signs.
functions.code:
def first_digit_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return int(str(abs(a))[0]) + int(str(abs(b))[0])

functions.name: last_digit_sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of the last decimal digits ignoring signs.
functions.code:
def last_digit_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) % 10 + abs(b) % 10

functions.name: digit_sum_total
functions.description: Returns the sum of all decimal digits of both integers ignoring signs.
functions.code:
def digit_sum_total(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return sum(int(ch) for ch in str(abs(a))) + sum(int(ch) for ch in str(abs(b)))

functions.name: digit_product_last_digits
functions.description: Returns the product of the last decimal digits ignoring signs.
functions.code:
def digit_product_last_digits(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (abs(a) % 10) * (abs(b) % 10)

functions.name: reverse_digits_sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of the digit-reversed absolute values.
functions.code:
def reverse_digits_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return int(str(abs(a))[::-1]) + int(str(abs(b))[::-1])

functions.name: concat_lengths
functions.description: Returns the digit length of the two absolute values concatenated.
functions.code:
def concat_lengths(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return len(str(abs(a)) + str(abs(b)))

functions.name: common_parity_value
functions.description: Returns the sum if the integers share parity, otherwise their difference.
functions.code:
def common_parity_value(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b if a % 2 == b % 2 else a - b

functions.name: larger_minus_smaller
functions.description: Returns the larger integer minus the smaller one.
functions.code:
def larger_minus_smaller(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a if a > b else b) - (a if a < b else b)

functions.name: sum_times_sign_of_a
functions.description: Returns the sum multiplied by the sign of the first integer.
functions.code:
def sum_times_sign_of_a(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + b) * (1 if a > 0 else -1 if a < 0 else 0)

functions.name: sum_times_sign_of_b
functions.description: Returns the sum multiplied by the sign of the second integer.
functions.code:
def sum_times_sign_of_b(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + b) * (1 if b > 0 else -1 if b < 0 else 0)

functions.name: abs_product_plus_one
functions.description: Returns the absolute product plus one.
functions.code:
def abs_product_plus_one(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a * b) + 1

functions.name: square_difference
functions.description: Returns the difference of the squares a^2 - b^2.
functions.code:
def square_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * a - b * b

functions.name: sum_of_squares_minus_product
functions.description: Returns the sum of squares minus the product.
functions.code:
def sum_of_squares_minus_product(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * a + b * b - a * b

functions.name: min_plus_abs_max
functions.description: Returns the smaller integer plus the absolute value of the larger.

functions.name: max_minus_abs_min
functions.description: Returns the larger integer minus the absolute value of the smaller.

functions.name: sum_clamped_nonnegative
functions.description: Returns the sum with negative inputs treated as zero.
functions.code:
def sum_clamped_nonnegative(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return max(a, 0) + max(b, 0)

functions.name: sum_clamped_nonpositive
functions.description: Returns the sum with positive inputs treated as zero.
functions.code:
def sum_clamped_nonpositive(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return min(a, 0) + min(b, 0)

functions.name: manhattan_to_pair
functions.description: Returns the Manhattan distance from the origin to the point (a, b).
functions.code:
def manhattan_to_pair(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) + abs(b)

functions.name: chebyshev_to_pair
functions.description: Returns the larger absolute coordinate of the pair.
functions.code:
def chebyshev_to_pair(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return max(abs(a), abs(b))

functions.name: taxicab_gap_to_equal
functions.description: Returns how many steps separate the two integers on the number line.
functions.code:
def taxicab_gap_to_equal(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a - b)

functions.name: nearest_to_zero
functions.description: Returns the integer that is closest to zero, preferring the smaller one on ties.

functions.name: farthest_from_zero
functions.description: Returns the integer that is farthest from zero, preferring the larger one on ties.

functions.name: sum_after_incrementing_first
functions.description: Returns the sum after increasing the first integer by one.
functions.code:
def sum_after_incrementing_first(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + 1) + b

functions.name: sum_after_decrementing_second
functions.description: Returns the sum after decreasing the second integer by one.
functions.code:
def sum_after_decrementing_second(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + (b - 1)

functions.name: product_after_increment_both
functions.description: Returns the product after increasing both integers by one.
functions.code:
def product_after_increment_both(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + 1) * (b + 1)

functions.name: product_after_decrement_both
functions.description: Returns the product after decreasing both integers by one.
functions.code:
def product_after_decrement_both(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a - 1) * (b - 1)

functions.name: sum_of_halves_floor
functions.description: Returns the sum of each integer floor-divided by two.
functions.code:
def sum_of_halves_floor(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a // 2 + b // 2

functions.name: difference_of_halves_floor
functions.description: Returns the first floor-divided by two minus the second floor-divided by two.
functions.code:
def difference_of_halves_floor(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a // 2 - b // 2

functions.name: triple_sum_minus_product
functions.description: Returns three times the sum minus the product.
functions.code:
def triple_sum_minus_product(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 3 * (a + b) - a * b

functions.name: product_plus_abs_difference
functions.description: Returns the product plus the absolute difference.
functions.code:
def product_plus_abs_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * b + abs(a - b)

functions.name: product_minus_abs_sum
functions.description: Returns the product minus the absolute value of the sum.
functions.code:
def product_minus_abs_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * b - abs(a + b)

functions.name: sum_squared
functions.description: Returns the square of the sum of the integers.

functions.name: difference_squared
functions.description: Returns the square of the difference a - b.

functions.name: modulo_sum_by_three
functions.description: Returns the remainder when the sum is divided by three.
functions.code:
def modulo_sum_by_three(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a + b) % 3

functions.name: modulo_difference_by_four
functions.description: Returns the remainder when the difference is divided by four.
functions.code:
def modulo_difference_by_four(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a - b) % 4

functions.name: sum_of_remainders_mod_three
functions.description: Returns the sum of each integer modulo three.
functions.code:
def sum_of_remainders_mod_three(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a % 3) + (b % 3)

functions.name: product_of_remainders_mod_four
functions.description: Returns the product of each integer modulo four.
functions.code:
def product_of_remainders_mod_four(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a % 4) * (b % 4)

functions.name: ones_if_sum_positive
functions.description: Returns 1 if the sum is positive, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def ones_if_sum_positive(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if a + b > 0 else 0

functions.name: ones_if_product_negative
functions.description: Returns 1 if the product is negative, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def ones_if_product_negative(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if a * b < 0 else 0

functions.name: zero_if_equal_else_sum
functions.description: Returns zero when the integers are equal, otherwise their sum.
functions.code:
def zero_if_equal_else_sum(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 0 if a == b else a + b

functions.name: zero_if_opposite_else_product
functions.description: Returns zero when the integers are opposites, otherwise their product.
functions.code:
def zero_if_opposite_else_product(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 0 if a == -b else a * b

functions.name: sum_without_larger
functions.description: Returns the sum after removing the larger input, leaving the smaller.
functions.code:
def sum_without_larger(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b - (a if a > b else b)

functions.name: sum_without_smaller
functions.description: Returns the sum after removing the smaller input, leaving the larger.
functions.code:
def sum_without_smaller(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b - (a if a < b else b)

functions.name: absolute_sum_minus_absolute_difference
functions.description: Returns the absolute sum minus the absolute difference.
functions.code:
def absolute_sum_minus_absolute_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a + b) - abs(a - b)

functions.name: absolute_sum_plus_absolute_difference
functions.description: Returns the absolute sum plus the absolute difference.
functions.code:
def absolute_sum_plus_absolute_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a + b) + abs(a - b)

functions.name: sum_of_signs
functions.description: Returns the sum of the signs of the two integers.
functions.code:
def sum_of_signs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    sa = 1 if a > 0 else -1 if a < 0 else 0
    sb = 1 if b > 0 else -1 if b < 0 else 0
    return sa + sb

functions.name: difference_of_signs
functions.description: Returns the sign of the first integer minus the sign of the second.
functions.code:
def difference_of_signs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    sa = 1 if a > 0 else -1 if a < 0 else 0
    sb = 1 if b > 0 else -1 if b < 0 else 0
    return sa - sb

functions.name: sum_with_first_abs
functions.description: Returns the absolute value of the first integer plus the second.
functions.code:
def sum_with_first_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) + b

functions.name: sum_with_second_abs
functions.description: Returns the first integer plus the absolute value of the second.
functions.code:
def sum_with_second_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + abs(b)

functions.name: product_with_first_abs
functions.description: Returns the absolute value of the first integer times the second.
functions.code:
def product_with_first_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) * b

functions.name: product_with_second_abs
functions.description: Returns the first integer times the absolute value of the second.
functions.code:
def product_with_second_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * abs(b)

functions.name: larger_times_two
functions.description: Returns twice the larger of the two integers.
functions.code:
def larger_times_two(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 2 * (a if a > b else b)

functions.name: smaller_times_three
functions.description: Returns three times the smaller of the two integers.
functions.code:
def smaller_times_three(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 3 * (a if a < b else b)

functions.name: sum_of_neighbors
functions.description: Returns the sum of each integer's immediate neighbors totalled together.
functions.code:
def sum_of_neighbors(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a - 1) + (a + 1) + (b - 1) + (b + 1)

functions.name: gap_from_abs_values
functions.description: Returns the absolute difference between the absolute values.
functions.code:
def gap_from_abs_values(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(abs(a) - abs(b))

functions.name: sum_of_max_and_min_abs
functions.description: Returns the sum of the larger and smaller absolute values.
functions.code:
def sum_of_max_and_min_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return max(abs(a), abs(b)) + min(abs(a), abs(b))

functions.name: count_digits_equal
functions.description: Returns 1 if the absolute values have the same number of digits, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def count_digits_equal(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if len(str(abs(a))) == len(str(abs(b))) else 0

functions.name: difference_in_digit_lengths
functions.description: Returns the difference in digit counts of the absolute values.
functions.code:
def difference_in_digit_lengths(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return len(str(abs(a))) - len(str(abs(b)))

functions.name: sum_of_first_and_last_digits
functions.description: Returns the sum of the first and last digits of both absolute values.

functions.name: middleless_two_digit_style
functions.description: Returns the sum after removing the last digit from each absolute value.
functions.code:
def middleless_two_digit_style(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) // 10 + abs(b) // 10

functions.name: last_digit_difference
functions.description: Returns the difference of the last digits of the absolute values.
functions.code:
def last_digit_difference(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) % 10 - abs(b) % 10

functions.name: sum_divisible_by_two_flag
functions.description: Returns 1 if the sum is even, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def sum_divisible_by_two_flag(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if (a + b) % 2 == 0 else 0

functions.name: difference_divisible_by_three_flag
functions.description: Returns 1 if the difference is divisible by three, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def difference_divisible_by_three_flag(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if (a - b) % 3 == 0 else 0

functions.name: product_divisible_by_five_flag
functions.description: Returns 1 if the product is divisible by five, otherwise 0.
functions.code:
def product_divisible_by_five_flag(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return 1 if (a * b) % 5 == 0 else 0

functions.name: sum_plus_max
functions.description: Returns the sum plus the larger integer.
functions.code:
def sum_plus_max(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b + (a if a > b else b)

functions.name: sum_plus_min
functions.description: Returns the sum plus the smaller integer.
functions.code:
def sum_plus_min(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b + (a if a < b else b)

functions.name: product_plus_max
functions.description: Returns the product plus the larger integer.
functions.code:
def product_plus_max(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * b + (a if a > b else b)

functions.name: product_plus_min
functions.description: Returns the product plus the smaller integer.
functions.code:
def product_plus_min(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * b + (a if a < b else b)

functions.name: sum_of_abs_neighbors
functions.description: Returns the sum of the absolute values of each input's neighbors.
functions.code:
def sum_of_abs_neighbors(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a - 1) + abs(a + 1) + abs(b - 1) + abs(b + 1)

functions.name: difference_between_max_abs_and_min_abs
functions.description: Returns the larger absolute value minus the smaller absolute value.
functions.code:
def difference_between_max_abs_and_min_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return max(abs(a), abs(b)) - min(abs(a), abs(b))

functions.name: sum_of_squares_of_abs
functions.description: Returns the sum of squares of the absolute values.
functions.code:
def sum_of_squares_of_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return abs(a) ** 2 + abs(b) ** 2

functions.name: first_if_even_else_second
functions.description: Returns the first integer if it is even, otherwise the second.
functions.code:
def first_if_even_else_second(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a if a % 2 == 0 else b

functions.name: second_if_odd_else_first
functions.description: Returns the second integer if it is odd, otherwise the first.
functions.code:
def second_if_odd_else_first(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return b if b % 2 != 0 else a

functions.name: sum_minus_smaller_abs
functions.description: Returns the sum minus the smaller absolute value.
functions.code:
def sum_minus_smaller_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b - min(abs(a), abs(b))

functions.name: sum_plus_larger_abs
functions.description: Returns the sum plus the larger absolute value.
functions.code:
def sum_plus_larger_abs(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b + max(abs(a), abs(b))
